answer.label: fine-tune backdoor
answer.justification: The activation profile matches fine-tune backdoor almost exactly. Relative L2 at layers 1/8/16/24/32 is 0.086/0.164/0.162/0.191/0.297 (reference values 0.091/0.174/0.169/0.193/0.295). Onset is at layer 3, the early-bump signature. The size ratio is 1.018, above 1, which rules out quantization (0.968). Effective rank is 3.62 (expected 3.5), direction consistency 0.625 (0.62), final cosine 0.952 (0.952), final-layer jump +0.038 (+0.03) and layer-2 spike 1.2 (1.1). Fine-tune bias, the closest alternative, is ruled out by its onset of 13–14, consistency of about 0.70, final value of about 0.41 and jump of +0.10. Both system-prompt classes are ruled out by their spike of about 40 and plateau of about 0.4 at mid-depth. Output and logit measurements were not available, so the call rests on activations alone.
